html: Started my M.S. in Electronics & Information Convergence Engineering at Kyung Hee University, joining the Intelligent Communications Systems Lab under Prof. Yun Hee Kim.
Awarded the Brain Korea 21 (BK21) FOUR research fellowship and the President’s Scholarship (full tuition) at Kyung Hee University.
Completed my research assistantship at the Laboratory of Signal and System Integration, Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières, on continual learning for MIMO-OFDM channel prediction.
Joined the Laboratory of Signal and System Integration, Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières, as a research assistant.
Started as a Teaching Assistant for Mobile Communication Systems (Fall 2024) at SEECS, NUST.
Graduated with a B.E. in Electrical Engineering from NUST, Islamabad.

Joined the Information Processing and Transmission Lab at NUST to work on safety-critical 5G URLLC for industrial IoT, in collaboration with Mid Sweden University and Manchester Metropolitan University.
